label: Smart Lock HGM (local)
info: Chay local: Node-RED + Mosquitto + SQLite. Khong can VPS.

Tao bang + seed admin

Chuan bi tin nhan Telegram
4. Node-RED -> home/hgm/command (remote unlock / lockdown tu web)
5. Subroutine dung chung: kiem tra session token (goi lai bang link call)

Xu ly dang nhap
Xu ly dang xuat
Xu ly quen mat khau

Tra ve lich su ra vao
Mo cua tu xa + ghi log
Bat/tat che do khoa chet
